name: Birmingham City

O.evidence: Controlled since July 2023 by Shelby Companies, a subsidiary of US investment firm Knighthead Capital (chair Tom Wagner), with Tom Brady as minority owner. Heavy investment in squad and a planned 'Sports Quarter' stadium development; broadly welcomed by fans but fund-backed.

adjustments.evidence: Majority owner is a subsidiary of Knighthead Capital Management, a US investment fund.

flags: Heavy owner-funded spending in League One and the Championship; consider an overspend adjustment (-2 to -3) if PSR losses are confirmed.
